**Game glow, folders, your own Home order, and NSXL Web.**

**Download `NSXL-v1.3.0.apk` below.** It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings.

### Game glow (new)
- **Home takes on the colours of the game you've selected.** NSXL reads the main colours from the game's art and fills the background glow with them, blending smoothly as you move along the row.
- **Turn it on in Settings › Themes › Game glow.** Choose *Background*, or *Background and accent* to also tint the game title, highlights and buttons.
- Works with Basic White and Basic Black, even with Moving background glow or Reduce motion on (the colours still change, without the drifting).

### Folders
- **Group your games.** Open a game's **Options › Folders** to put it in a folder or make a new one. You can also make folders in **All Software › Folders**.
- **Games in a folder live only in that folder.** They leave the Home row and All Software. Remove a game from its folder to bring it back.
- **Folders sit on Home** with a preview of the games inside. Choose *Show on Home* or *Remove from Home* in the folder's options.
- **Folders open like Home:** a big row of the folder's game tiles.
- **Sort the games inside:** your order, A–Z, Z–A, recently played or most played. Press Y, or tap the sort button.
- **Arrange them yourself:** pick *Move* on a game, slide it with ◀ ▶ and press A.

### Arrange your Home row
- Choose **Options › Move on Home** on any game or folder, slide it with ◀ ▶ and press A.
- **Settings › Home Screen › Home order**: *Recently played first* or *Your order*.

### A new wake animation
- **The NSXL ring unwinds out of black, then Home settles in behind it:** tiles slide into place, and the clock and footer ease in last. It's the reverse of the sleep animation.
- **It now plays when you can see it.** It used to run behind the lock screen. Now it waits until you've unlocked, and Home stays dark until then so nothing flashes first.

### Polish
- **Settings are easier to read.** Each setting's description now sits under its name instead of squeezed beside it.
- **Notifications** now drop in at the top of the screen, clear of the dock and button hints.
- **Bigger tiles in All Software**, so names fit.
- **Play time cards** no longer cut off (for example "3h 20m").
- **News** shows its loading status under the tabs instead of over them.
- Smoother text and steady-width numbers on the clock and stats.
- NSXL follows your phone's *Remove animations* setting, as well as Calm mode.

### NSXL Web (new since v1.1.1)
- **The Web button opens NSXL Web** instead of your phone's browser. It has an NSXL-styled toolbar, a start page with search, bookmarks and shortcuts (YouTube, Twitch, Xbox Cloud Gaming, GeForce NOW, Steam and more), and it follows your Basic White or Basic Black theme.
- **Browse with a controller like on a console:**
  - Left stick or D-pad: move the pointer. Push past the top or bottom edge to scroll the page.
  - A: click
  - Right stick: scroll, including inner panels
  - B: back, or close the browser when there's nothing to go back to
  - L/R: back and forward
  - L2/R2: zoom out and in
  - X: reload
  - Y: type an address or search
  - +: menu
  - −: start page
  - Button hints match your controller. They only appear when you're using one, and hide again as soon as you touch the screen.
- **Its own transition:** NSXL Web rises into place while Home eases back behind it, and drops away when you close it.
- **Menu:** bookmarks, choose Google, DuckDuckGo or Bing, request the desktop site, zoom, share a link, open the page in another browser, clear history and cookies.
- **Full-screen video, file uploads and app links** (Play Store, YouTube app and so on) all work. Downloads are handed to your phone's download handler.
- **News stories open in NSXL Web.** Prefer your own browser? Turn off **Settings › News › Open stories in NSXL Web**.

### Also in this version
- Button icons no longer appear when no controller is connected. Some phones list built-in sensors as controllers; NSXL now ignores anything without real face buttons.
- The start-up fixes from v1.1.1, if you skipped it: no wallpaper flash, starts in landscape, and a smoother start-up ring.
